scope.review_inputs: Current source, deterministic synthetic images/geometry, prediction-only extraction protocol/seal and evidence inventory metadata

conclusion: The optional pipeline implements immutable image-derived anchor measurements, bounded fixed-reference pose protection, lower-evidence visible supplementation and separately labelled rigid projection of all eight corners. No open material blocker was found after the listed owner fixes. Numerical guards and conditional covariance do not certify physical-corner identity or GT accuracy; no empirical superiority is concluded by this review.

method_contract.observations: Original raw/fused/image anchors remain immutable. Accepted typed RGB junctions enter a copied working measurement array only after input/image/native/actual-line/covariance/SIGMA2 validation. Projection is never their measurement source.
method_contract.eligibility: Fixed initial H/outline/truncation, actual raw missing/OOB, semantic RGB visibility and independent other-instance exclusions precede admission. Actual RGB precision cue remains separate from semantic visibility.
method_contract.protection: Per-anchor unweighted Huber loss increase and 2px projection movement are measured from one frozen accepted boundary seed/first measured bootstrap, never the last incremental step. No exact noisy-pixel clamp.
method_contract.three_point_policy: Translation-only bootstrap with exact initial R is a conservative policy, not a proof that calibrated P3P cannot estimate full pose. Later full-rank additions can estimate6DOF and change R; returned DOF and physical rotation are explicit.
method_contract.anchor_priority: Expanded checkpoints need fixed immutable-pool gain and configured anchor protection. If none pass, independently boundary-rule accepted seed may be retained under named full-pool exception. Without that seed, failure returns exact initial pose.
method_contract.strict_eligible_pool: No seed exception; seed can be vetoed by final immutable-pool test.
method_contract.completion: One supplied registered rigid model projects all eight final corners, including measured and excluded slots; original ninth centre retained. Measurements, residuals, used IDs and model projections are separate outputs.
method_contract.physical_basis: Fixed upstream model/native order and Q conversion maintained; no W/D family switch or per-frame GT correspondence selection. Three-DOF path restores both rotation matrices exactly.
method_contract.uncertainty: Weighted local-L2 information surrogate under assumed1px noise, distinct data-only rank/nullspace, prior information fraction and conditional projected covariance. It is not the exact Huber Hessian or calibrated correctness interval.
method_contract.external_occlusion: Palette/mask/gradient negatives imply unknown possibilities, not another-object certification. Caller-supplied independent instance evidence can veto; confirmed foreground ordering needs independently bound physical requested-point depth, not initial model depth.

remaining_limits: Initial pose-based self-occlusion, truncation, outline, incident directions and native family can be wrong.
Rounded/virtual cuboid corners, pallet holes, repeated grids and face-junction ambiguity can produce wrong physical correspondence despite real pixel gradient/line support.

Gradient/source values are generated by the trusted image observer. The pure cached validator checks supplied facts and current-image hash binding but does not independently resample RGB or certify semantic identity. Null actual image hash is an explicitly unbound cached-caller contract; production API supplies it.

Line/corner covariance and assumed detector sigma2 omit semantic bias, model/camera/dimension error, raw-detector correlation and shared-edge dependence. Fixed-R translation covariance is conditional on that upstream rotation, not total pose uncertainty.
Protected seed can itself be wrong; the anchor-priority exception deliberately does not promise all-visible objective improvement. Protection also does not guarantee GT pixel or pose improvement.
No hard output anchor clamp: final rigid corner coordinates can differ from immutable measurements within declared guards. All eight projected corners remain inferred outputs.
Finite four-point multistarts do not prove global uniqueness. A valid local Jacobian rank is numerical information, not requested-corner semantic correctness.

Related-work novelty and best-method claims require controlled evidence. Visibility selection, uncertainty-awarePnP, iterative refinement and visible-to-hidden inference have prior primary literature.
CAL-selected options and already-seen TEST49 cannot establish independent generalization or per-frame method superiority; retain old baseline anchors and all failure/fallback cases.
recommendation: Proceed with the fixed finite CAL experiment and sealed matched exploratory replay. Expose seed-exception/accepted-DOF/measurement-versus-projection provenance and claim limits. No additional parameter search or experiment is requested by this review.
